s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, roll each into a 20cm rope and tie into a knot. Lay on a lined tray and rest 15 minutes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until golden. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Brush the hot knots all over and scatter with 40g finely grated parmesan. Serve with 300ml warmed marinara sauce.

s.n: Greeting card cheese and tomato pinwheels
s.note: the greeting card poems Deeds writes
s.how: Lay 2 sheets thawed puff pastry flat. Spread each with 2 tbsp sundried tomato pesto, then top with 4 slices of ham, a few basil leaves and 60g grated tasty cheese. Roll up tightly, chill for 15 minutes, then cut each roll into 12 slices. Lay cut-side down on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.

m.how: Divide 750g pizza dough into 2 and stretch each into a 30cm round on oiled trays. Spread each with 100ml pizza sauce. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms with 1 crushed garlic clove in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Top the bases with 300g grated mozzarella, 120g pepperoni and the mushrooms. Bake at 240C for 12 to 14 minutes until blistered. Scatter with dried oregano and drizzle with chilli oil.

w.n: New York baked cheesecake with berries
w.note: Deeds's time in New York City
w.how: Crush 200g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 80g melted butter. Press into a lined 20cm springform tin and chill. Beat 500g soft cream cheese with 150g caster sugar, then beat in 3 eggs, 150g sour cream, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp vanilla. Pour over the base and bake at 150C for 55 minutes until just set. Cool in the oven with the door ajar, then chill 4 hours. Simmer 300g frozen berries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes and spoon over.

d.note: the small-town spot back in Mandrake Falls
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each glass. Slowly pour cold cola down the side of each glass until it foams to the top, letting it settle and topping up, about 300ml per glass. Finish with a spoon of whipped cream from 100ml thickened cream and a cocktail cherry. Serve with straws and long spoons.
